# `aitbc ai submit`

Submit a new AI job to the coordinator with a prompt and optional model.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc ai submit [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet name |
| `--type` | text | — | no | Job type |
| `--prompt` | text | — | no | Job prompt |
| `--model` | text | — | no | Ollama model to use |
| `--payment` | float | — | no | Payment amount |
| `--currency` | text | — | no | Payment currency (default: AITBC) |
| `--buyer-address` | text | — | no | Customer wallet address for escrow |
| `--provider-address` | text | — | no | Provider wallet address for escrow |
| `--offer-id` | text | — | no | Market offer this job is bought against |
| `--offer-quantity` | Decimal | — | no | How many of the offer's price units to buy (default: 1) |
| `--acceptance-window` | integer | — | no | Seconds after completion before payment auto-releases (default: 0) |
| `--min-reputation` | float | — | no | Minimum provider reputation score (0-1) required for this job |
| `--zk-proof-required`, `--no-zk-proof-required` | flag | `false` | no | Require a ZK receipt proof before escrow release |
| `--tee-attestation-required`, `--no-tee-attestation-required` | flag | `false` | no | Require a TEE attestation before escrow release |
| `--tee-enclave-id` | text | — | no | Required TEE enclave identity |
| `--confidential` | flag | `false` | no | Mark this job as confidential (requires a TEE attestation) |
| `--enclave-measurement` | text | — | no | Required enclave measurement for a confidential job |
| `--auto-reinvest-pct` | float | — | no | Percentage of released payment to auto-stake as reinvestment |
| `--bond-required`, `--no-bond-required` | flag | `false` | no | Require the provider to have an active performance bond |
| `--min-bond-amount` | float | — | no | Minimum bond amount required for provider eligibility |
| `--deterministic-decoding`, `--no-deterministic-decoding` | flag | `false` | no | Use deterministic decoding for reproducible verification |
| `--decode-seed` | integer | — | no | Seed for deterministic decoding (auto-assigned if unset) |
| `--input` | text | — | no | Input URL or path for transcribe/reencode jobs |
| `--output-format` | text | — | no | Output format for reencode jobs (e.g. mp4, mp3) |
| `--classification` | text | — | no | Data classification label (e.g. public, pii, phi) |
| `--compliance-framework` | text | — | no | Compliance framework to enforce |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | RPC URL |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--wait` | flag | `false` | no | Wait for the job to reach a terminal state |
| `--timeout` | float | `300` | no | Maximum seconds to wait for a terminal state (default: 300) |
| `--poll-interval` | float | `5` | no | Seconds between status polls (default: 5) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc ai submit
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc ai submit --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
